name: OKR Summary
query: select c.name as cycle, c.cycle_name, c.company, count(distinct o.name) as objective_count, count(distinct k.name) as key_result_count, round(avg(o.progress), 2) as organization_progress from `tabOKR Cycle` c left join `tabOKR Objective` o on o.cycle = c.name left join `tabOKR Key Result` k on k.cycle = c.name group by c.name, c.cycle_name, c.company order by c.modified desc
